name: VoiceDrop
summary: Ringless voicemail platform for US outreach with AI voices, voice cloning, CRM and Zapier integrations, and usage-based pricing.
best_for: US sales teams, lenders and local service businesses that want to send personalised voicemails at volume and pay per delivered message
skip_if: you contact people outside the US, you want to reach landlines, you cannot confirm that your list and message comply with phone marketing rules, or you want a tool we have tested ourselves
honest_knock: Delivery is US only and excludes landlines. The callback rates on the page are the vendor's own and cannot be checked. A card is needed for the trial. We have not checked the rules on ringless voicemail in your state, so ask before you send to a purchased list.

pricing.entry_price_terms: Budget · Budget $95 a month with 500 voice units
pricing.notes: (read 2026-11-15 on voicedrop.ai/pricing and the home page FAQ, US dollars a month) VoiceDrop sells ringless voicemail by usage units. Budget costs $95 a month for 500 units and 1,000 static voicemails, with one voice clone seat and no account manager. Individual costs $495 a month for 6,500 units. Growth costs $995 a month for 15,000 units and includes an account manager. Scale costs $1,995 a month for 40,000 units. Enterprise has custom pricing from 1,000,000 units. One unit spans 150 to 500 characters of your script and a static recording costs 0.5 units. You are charged only for successful deliveries, and unused units roll over for 90 days. Choosing quarterly billing saves 8% and annual billing gives 2 months free. A card is needed for the 7-day free trial, which includes $20 of credits, about 200 messages. Calls that come in to your VoiceDrop numbers cost 2 cents a minute, rounded up to the full minute. We have not paid for a plan.

exit_test.what: We created the account and our AI assistant ran the test in our browser. On 19 November 2026 the session tested VoiceDrop in the 7-day trial that we started with our card. The billing page matched the dossier price of $495 a month after the trial, but no voicemail campaign could be set up without verifying your own phone number or buying one, which was outside our limits. Cancelling worked in the app the same day, after 9 screens with four retention offers. Account and start: we created the account and started the 7-day trial of the Individuals plan with his own card; our AI assistant ran the test in our browser, in its own tab, on 19 November 2026. The interface was in English. The onboarding asked 6 questions (source, volume, goal, value of callbacks, CRM, team) and no identity check and no card. The dashboard showed Get Started, 2 of 5 steps completed, and a timer banner promising 1,000 extra voice units for launching a campaign to 100+ numbers within about two hours. Billing showed VoiceDrop - Individuals Plan, Monthly, Trial, Free trial: $0 charged so far, Subscription Units 263 trial units, Voice Units Used 0, Available Balance 263, Plan price after trial $495.00 and Free trial ends Nov 26, 2026, 10:51 AM GMT+1, with Smart Renewal On, which tops up units automatically. Core action, a voicemail campaign: Voice Clones was empty and a clone needs your own recording, which was not made. The campaign wizard said You're already 33% set up and asked for a sender number: verify your own number or buy a dedicated number. Both were outside the test limits (no number bought, no phone verification), so no list, script or send was made and nothing was spent. Plans: Billing offered Upgrade to the Growth Plan, 3 Voices, 5+ Campaigns, 15.000 Units, $995/mo Billed Monthly; nothing was clicked. The price after the trial is $495 a month for Individual. Checkout: the trial checkout was done by us before the session and was not seen. Cancelling, done in the app the same day: avatar, Manage Billing, Cancel subscription. The flow had 9 screens: Are you sure you want to cancel?; a warning that your data will be deleted with a link to pause instead (offer 1); a reason screen with I got charged during my free trial or Other reason, where we typed Just testing; We'll match the price (offer 2); Need a More Affordable Option? with Downgrade my Plan (offer 3); a Billing Information form with a box to confirm the billing details; a second Are you sure you want to cancel? with a box to confirm that the account data will be lost; A better price before you go with 25% off for 3 cycles (offer 4); and Select subscription to cancel. No offer was accepted. The end screen said Your plan is cancelled. You won't be charged again. Ended Nov 19, 2026., and Billing then showed No Subscription and Choose a Plan. The plan ended at once, on 19 November 2026 at 12:08 UTC, not at the end of the trial. Not tested: voice cloning or text to speech, a script, a list import, a campaign and its delivery rate, callbacks, compliance checks and the cost per drop. Clean up: the account stays without a subscription; the own tab was closed. No kit records were entered.
exit_test.awkward: You cannot try a campaign in the trial without verifying your own number or buying one. Cancelling takes 9 screens with four retention offers and two warnings that your data will be deleted, and it ends the plan at once rather than at the end of the trial.
